claims.quote: Start with a US$300 cloud credit.* You’ll have 30 days to use it to test your applications on all OCI services, in addition to Always Free Services in your Free Tier account.
One Oracle Cloud Free Trial or Always Free account is permitted per person.
The US$300 cloud credit is available in select countries and valid for up to 30 days.
